company_overview: MyncAdz is an ad‑space marketplace that connects screen owners with advertisers, enabling listing, booking, and management of digital display advertising across high‑footfall venues. It also offers enterprise‑grade solutions and screen‑installation services.
target_audience: Screen owners with digital displays, advertisers looking to reach real people in physical locations, and enterprises running large‑scale out‑of‑home campaigns.
